A. into
B. before
C. beside

items.question: New patients are advised to arrive fifteen minutes ----- their appointment time in order to complete the required paperwork.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“before”代入题干后为“New patients are advised to arrive fifteen minutes before their appointment time in order to complete the required paperwork.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：B（before）。
